verified_facts.text: The hotel sits at the edge of Lake Leman (Lake Geneva) with views of the Jet d'Eau and Mont Blanc.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elegantly poised at the edge of Lake Leman with magnificent views of the famous Jet d’Eau and Mont Blanc

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is Quai du Mont-Blanc 17, Geneva.
verified_facts.excerpt: Quai du Mont-Blanc 17, Geneva, Switzerland

verified_facts.text: A short boat ride connects the hotel to the city centre, with the Flower Clock, the Old Town and the Patek Philippe Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: A short boat ride connects you to the city centre, where you can admire the famous Flower Clock, wander through the Old Town, or visit the remarkable Patek Philippe Museum.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was built in 1872 with a facade designed by architect Anthony Krafft.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built in 1872, the hotel is a true city landmark, with an impressive facade designed by celebrated architect Anthony Krafft.

verified_facts.text: In 1960 the hotel was acknowledged as one of the heritage sites of the city of Geneva.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel d'Angleterre was acknowledged as one of the heritage sites of the city of Geneva.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are individually styled, with art, elegant furnishings and marble-lined bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel d'Angleterre offers a range of sumptuous, individually styled rooms and suites, all bedecked in exquisite art and elegant furnishings and complemented by marble-lined bathrooms.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are filled with curated antique pieces and pieces of art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each is filled with carefully curated antique pieces & fascinating pieces of art

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Savoir beds with Swiss quality Elite mattresses and evening turndown.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Savoir beds and Swiss quality Elite mattress
- Feather duvet and pillow selection
- Evening turndown

verified_facts.text: Le 17 Restaurant has panoramic views across Lake Leman towards Mont Blanc and cooking shaped by fire and seasonality.
verified_facts.excerpt: Panoramic views extend across Lake Léman towards Mont Blanc at Le 17 Restaurant, forming a striking backdrop to a dining experience shaped by fire and seasonality.

verified_facts.text: Executive Chef Alexandre Cardiga leads the hotel's culinary offering.
verified_facts.excerpt: Executive Chef Alexandre Cardiga and his talented team lead a diverse culinary offering throughout the hotel

verified_facts.text: The cellar holds over 225 bins, with a wine list created by Master Sommelier Julien Meurillon.
verified_facts.excerpt: With over 225 bins in our cellar, Julien Meurillon, our Master Sommelier has created an elegant and stylish wine list

verified_facts.text: The traditional afternoon tea includes scones with Gruyeres double cream and homemade jam.
verified_facts.excerpt: scones (plain, raisin and chocolate) with Gruyeres double cream and homemade jam

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea comes with Betjeman and Barton teas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your tea stand will be accompanied by a choice of refreshing Betjeman and Barton teas

verified_facts.text: The Leopard Bar offers creative cocktails and live jazz sessions from local bands.
verified_facts.excerpt: With its vibrant atmosphere, creative cocktails, and live jazz sessions from top local bands, it's the perfect place to unwind.

verified_facts.text: The Leopard Bar drinks menu features over 50 whiskies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our extensive drinks menu features fine wines, classic and innovative cocktails, and over 50 whiskies.

verified_facts.text: The Leopard Bar serves fresh sushi and light bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savour fresh sushi, tasty light bites, and expertly crafted cocktails at Leopard Bar.

verified_facts.text: The Cigar Lounge in the Leopard Bar has an air-flow extraction system in the floor and the ceiling's wooden panelling.
verified_facts.excerpt: it boasts a cutting-edge air-flow extraction system in the floor and the ceiling’s wooden panelling, to ensure relaxation in total comfort.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join Executive Chef Alexandre Cardiga at the Geneva Market to select ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Accompany our Executive Chef, Alexandre Cardiga, to the Geneva Market, where he will guide you through the process of selecting the finest ingredients.

verified_facts.text: A make-your-own-watch experience takes place at the Initium Workshop in Geneva.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the heart of Geneva, enter the Initium Workshop, where you will learn the fundamentals of watchmaking.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a local Swiss fisherman on Lake Leman for a three-hour fishing tour.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join a seasoned local Swiss fisherman on Lake Leman for a three-hour fishing tour

verified_facts.text: The lake fishing experience runs from May to September, depending on weather.
verified_facts.excerpt: Subject to availability, from May to September, depending on weather conditions.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a private cruise on Lake Geneva aboard a Bow Rider boat with afternoon tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step aboard a 'Bow Rider' boat for a private cruise on Lake Geneva.

verified_facts.text: The Tea on Lake Geneva boat experience is available from June to September.
verified_facts.excerpt: Available from June to September.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the hotel as a family-run boutique hotel where every room has views of the lake or Jet d'Eau.
verified_facts.excerpt: every room in this c. 1872 family-run boutique hotel offers views of the lake or Jet d'Eau

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes tables repurposed from vintage Louis Vuitton suitcases.
verified_facts.excerpt: Remember to check out the tables, repurposed from vintage Louis Vuitton suitcases.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is listed in Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2017 through 2024.
